title: Deep Six
tagline: Six floors down. You will not survive the first few runs.
description: A small turn-based dungeon with permanent death and a long memory. Every run ends, and every run pays out echoes you spend on what you start with next time — a blade, a coat, a lantern that shows you more of the dark. The dungeon is new each run; what you have earned is not.
author: HexCave
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move and attack
howToPlay: Move with the arrow keys or WASD. It is turn-based: nothing moves until you do.
Walk into a monster to attack it. It will hit back, and so will anything else next to you.
You can only see what your lamp reaches, but everywhere you have been stays on the map.
Pink dots are potions — walk over one to pick it up, and press Q to drink. Gold dots are echo shards, which are worth something upstairs.
The green circle is the way down. Reaching it takes you to the next of six floors.
Death is permanent for that run, but you keep the echoes you earned. Spend them between runs on what you carry down next time.
goal: Reach the sixth floor and kill what is down there. Everything you earn on the way is kept even when you die.
